parameters.type: complex vector space equipped with a representation of sl₂(C), written V=V(λ)

definitions.type: positive integer, used as a natural number

definitions.definition: For every i∈I, e_i=y^i v/i!, with 0!=1 and powers acting by composition.

definitions.type: family of complex-linear endomorphisms of V indexed by natural numbers
definitions.definition: For every integer r≥0, X_r=x^r/r!, including X_0=Id_V.

definitions.type: family of complex-linear endomorphisms of V indexed by natural numbers
definitions.definition: For every integer r≥0, Y_r=y^r/r!, including Y_0=Id_V.

definitions.type: integer subalgebra of the universal enveloping algebra acting on V
definitions.definition: U_Z is the integer subalgebra of the universal enveloping algebra of sl₂(C) generated by X_r=x^r/r! and Y_r=y^r/r! for all integers r≥0; its action on V is the given representation extended to the enveloping algebra.

definitions.type: subring of Q, embedded in C
definitions.definition: R=Z_(p)={a/b∈Q:a,b∈Z and p does not divide b}, with operations inherited from Q. A unit of R means an element having a multiplicative inverse in R.
M_R is the R-span of M in V, namely all finite sums of r_j m_j with r_j∈R and m_j∈M. The canonical map R⊗_Z M→M_R sends r⊗m to rm; its injectivity is to be proved, not assumed.
For i,j∈I, E_ij is the unique complex-linear map with E_ij(e_k)=δ_jk e_i for all k∈I, where δ_jk is 1 if j=k and 0 otherwise. This construction requires that e be a complex basis of V.

definitions.type: family of R-submodules of C indexed by I
definitions.definition: For each i∈I, J_i={c∈C:c e_i∈M_R}, with addition and R-action inherited from C.

V(K)=M⊗_Z K. Here tensor products have their usual balanced-module meaning: they are generated by pure tensors subject to additivity in each argument and (am)⊗c=m⊗(ac) for the base scalar a∈Z, m∈M and c∈K. Induced lattice endomorphisms act on the M factor; the same symbols x,y,h denote these induced K-linear operators once preservation of M is established.

L(K) is the scalar extension to K of the free rank-three Chevalley Z-Lie algebra on formal basis ξ,η,ζ, with brackets [ζ,ξ]=2ξ, [ζ,η]=-2η, [ξ,η]=ζ, extended bilinearly and antisymmetrically with zero self-brackets. This is (Zx+Zy+Zh)⊗_Z K in the original notation, with ξ,η,ζ labeled there by x,y,h. These are abstract Chevalley generators, not their possibly nonfaithful operator images on V. The generators ξ⊗1,η⊗1,ζ⊗1 act on V(K) by the operators x,y,h induced from M. This is the Chevalley construction also in characteristic 2.

definitions.definition: For every natural d, factorial(d)=d!=∏_{t=1}^d t; the product for d=0 is 1.
For natural a,r, binom(a,r) is the number of r-element subsets of {1,...,a}; in particular it is zero for r>a and binom(a,0)=1.

full_target:
Let \(p\) be any prime, \(K\) any field of characteristic \(p\), and
\(\lambda\) an integer with \(0\leq\lambda<p\).
Let \(V(\lambda)\) be the complex irreducible highest-weight
\(\mathfrak{sl}_2(\mathbb C)\)-module of highest weight \(\lambda\),
of dimension \(\lambda+1\). Its Chevalley generators satisfy

\[
[h,x]=2x,\qquad[h,y]=-2y,\qquad[x,y]=h.
\]

Choose a nonzero highest-weight vector \(v\) with \(xv=0\) and
\(hv=\lambda v\). Let \(U_{\mathbb Z}\) be the integer subalgebra of
the universal enveloping algebra generated by all divided powers
\(X_r=x^r/r!\), \(Y_r=y^r/r!\), for integers \(r\geq0\).
An **admissible lattice** \(M\subset V(\lambda)\) is a free abelian
subgroup with an integer basis that is also a complex basis, stable under
\(U_{\mathbb Z}\). It is arbitrary, not necessarily the minimal lattice.

Put \(V(K)=M\otimes_{\mathbb Z}K\). The Lie algebra
\(L(K)=(\mathbb Zx+\mathbb Zy+\mathbb Zh)\otimes_{\mathbb Z}K\)
acts by the induced lattice operators. This is the Chevalley
\(\mathfrak{sl}_2\) construction also in characteristic 2.
Prove that \(V(K)\) is nonzero and every \(K\)-linear subspace
invariant under \(x,y,h\) is zero or all of \(V(K)\).
Both \(\lambda=0\) and \(p=2\) are included; \(K\) need not be
algebraically closed.

hypotheses.statement: p is prime, K has characteristic p, and 0≤λ<p.
V=V(λ) is the complex irreducible highest-weight sl₂(C)-module of highest weight λ and complex dimension λ+1. The Chevalley generator endomorphisms satisfy hx-xh=2x, hy-yh=-2y, and xy-yx=h.

M is an admissible lattice: it is a free abelian subgroup of V admitting an integer basis that is also a complex basis of V, and is stable under U_Z. The choice of M is arbitrary, not restricted to the minimal lattice.
